title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - WaterDevice
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/WaterDevice. A water device is a device that is also a water asset. Subclass of WaterAsset and saref:Device per the SAREF4WATR ontology (saref:Device imported, not separately modeled here). This is the root device class: FireHydrant, Pump and Valve inherit these properties with no additions of their own, while WaterMeter adds further properties of its own. Own properties: hasFabricationNumber, hasFirmwareVersion, hasHardwareVersion, operatesAtRadioFrequency, requiresPower.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WaterDevice'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasFabricationNumber.description: Property. subPropertyOf saref:hasIdentifier. The fabrication number of a device. Maps to s4watr:hasFabricationNumber.

hasFirmwareVersion.description: Property. subPropertyOf saref:hasVersion. The firmware version of a device. Maps to s4watr:hasFirmwareVersion.

hasHardwareVersion.description: Property. subPropertyOf saref:hasVersion. The hardware version of a device. Maps to s4watr:hasHardwareVersion.

operatesAtRadioFrequency.description: Property. The radio frequency (Hz) at which a device operates. Maps to s4watr:operatesAtRadioFrequency.

requiresPower.description: Property. The power (W) required by a device. Maps to s4watr:requiresPower.

location.description: Geoproperty. Geojson reference to the item. Maps to geo:hasGeometry in the SAREF4WATR/GeoSPARQL ontology.
